plugins.name: File Mode
plugins.description: For models requested with a configurable prefix (default file-), sends the new user turn as .md file attachments and turns the model's submit_reply tool call back into a plain text reply. Works across OpenAI-compatible, Codex, Claude and Gemini upstreams.
plugins.author: yuanwangz

zh-CN.description: 模型名带指定前缀（默认 file-）时，把本轮新用户消息的正文作为 .md 附件发给模型，并把模型的 submit_reply 工具调用还原成普通文字回复。上游为 OpenAI 兼容、Codex、Claude、Gemini 均可用。
